summary: At the start of the Fight phase, target a friendly Orks unit within 12" and roll a die: a 1 deals this model D3 mortal wounds, a 2-5 gives that unit's melee weapons +1 Strength, a 6 also grants them Lethal Hits, until the end of the phase.

name: Spiteful Power Trip
summary: While this unit makes attacks against a target unit that contains no models with a Toughness characteristic of 7 or more, add 1 to those attacks' Hit rolls.

name: Splat!
summary: Ranged attacks from this unit against a large or full-strength enemy unit re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

name: Squig Barrage
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by this unit's Squig Launchas weapons, excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units. That enemy unit is covered in Squigs until the start of your next turn. While a unit is covered in Squigs, that unit's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

name: Squig Mine
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, this model can target an enemy unit within 3": on a 4+ that unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

name: Stompin’ Forward
summary: This model can make Normal, Advance or Fall Back moves through models, excluding Titanic, and terrain features up to 4" tall as if they were not there.

name: Sumfin’ to Prove
summary: Melee attacks made by this unit have +1 to hit rolls.

name: Super Runts
summary: This unit is riled up. This unit's Scavenged Shivs weapons have +1 A, +1 WS and +1 S.

name: Support Shokka
summary: While this model is within 3" of a friendly Orks Infantry unit, excluding Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun units, this model has Lone Operative.

name: Supreme Kunnin’ (Once per phase, per army)
summary: Once per phase, per army. In the opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to D6"; or, if this unit is riled up, make a normal move of up to 5".

name: Taktikal Know-wotz
summary: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can split this unit into two units, each with a starting strength of 5. If you do, select which one of those units has the Bomb Squig ability and which one has the Found 'Em! ability.

name: Tellyporta Tech
summary: While attached to a unit, models in that unit gain the Deep Strike ability.

name: That’ll Learn Ya (Once per battle round, per unit)
summary: Usable once per battle round, per unit. When this unit becomes battle-shocked, if this unit contains 4+ Gretchin models, you can roll one D3. That number of Gretchin models in this unit are destroyed, and this unit is no longer battle-shocked.

name: Thievin’ Scavengers
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.

name: Throttlerokkit Shokka Engine
summary: In your Command phase, choose one of several listed abilities for this model to have until your next Command phase.

name: Thundering Stampede
summary: While attached to a unit, Charge rolls made for that unit gain +1.

name: Thundering Stampede (Aura)
summary: Friendly Beast Snagga units within 6" of this unit have +1 to charge rolls.

name: Tide of Muscle
summary: In the Fight phase, if this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit's melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

name: Tramplasquig Charge
summary: When this unit is targeted with the Crushing Impact stratagem, that use of the stratagem costs 1 fewer CP.

name: Trample
summary: When this model fights, it can target an engaged enemy unit and roll a die, +2 if it charged this turn: a 4-5 deals D3 mortal wounds, a 6+ deals 3 mortal wounds.

name: Trophy Hunters
summary: This unit has +1 to charge rolls.

name: Turbo Engine
summary: This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Unstable Oracle
summary: While attached to a unit, this model's signature weapon gains +2 Attacks for every 5 models in that unit, rounding down, but gains the Hazardous ability once the unit has 10 or more models.

name: Waaagh! Banner
summary: This unit has +1 to charge rolls.

name: Waaagh! Effigy
summary: This unit is riled up.

name: Waaagh! Effigy (Aura)
summary: Friendly Orks units within 12" of this model add 1 to their Battle-shock tests.

name: Waaagh! Energy
summary: While attached to a unit, this model's signature weapon gains +1 Strength and +1 Damage for every 5 models in that unit, rounding down, but gains the Hazardous ability once the unit has 10 or more models.

name: Waaagh! Energy (psyker level 1)
summary: This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Psychic Abilities section (see above).

name: WAAAGH! WAZDAKKA
summary: If this model is your Warlord, friendly Warbiker units gain the Battleline keyword.

name: Walking Bastion
summary: This model does not suffer the usual penalty to ranged Hit rolls while enemy units are within Engagement Range of it.

name: Wall of Dakka
summary: Ranged attacks from this model against a target within half range gain +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Warpath (psychic level 1)
summary: In the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; this unit's melee attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1; and this unit's melee attacks have [Psychic].

name: Wild Ride
summary: This unit can ignore any modifiers applied to its Move characteristic or to its Advance and Charge rolls.

name: Workshop
summary: Parts of this fortification must be set up within 1" of each other; at the end of your Movement phase, each friendly Orks Vehicle within 12" can regain up to D3 lost wounds, once per model per turn.

name: Wurrboy (psyker level 1)
summary: This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Psychic Abilities section (see above).

name: Da Boss
summary: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, you gain 1CP.

name: Unstable Energies
summary: ORKS PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name. In a battle round, a friendly ORKS PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit's psyker level.

name: Waaagh!
summary: Friendly ORKS units with this ability can re-roll Advance rolls, and can become riled up as stated in other rules. While a unit is riled up: it has 5+ InSv; its ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]; and when it is selected to make an Advance move, that Advance move does not prevent it from being eligible to declare a charge. War Cry (once per battle, per army): at the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability; if you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.
